name: Taiwan

income_tax.summary: Resident individuals pay progressive tax of 5% to 40% (top rate above TWD 4.98m), plus an alternative minimum tax. Employees' own social insurance is small: labor insurance 2.3%, employment insurance 0.2% (both capped at TWD 45,800 monthly insured salary) and national health insurance about 1.55% (insured-salary cap TWD 313,000). The Employment Gold Card exempts 50% of salary above TWD 3m for up to five years.
income_tax.self_employed_notes: Self-employed contribution rules (occupational union, higher NHI share) could not be found on any opened page (NHI and Bureau of Labor Insurance pages returned 403/404), so the self-employed rate is a PLACEHOLDER equal to the employee NHI share and is not verified; the real cost is probably higher because the employer's share falls on the self-employed person.
income_tax.local_tax_note: No local income tax. Rates are for the 2025 return (filed 2026), the latest on PwC (page reviewed 20 August 2026); 2026 rates were not published. Allowance = personal exemption TWD 97,000 + standard deduction TWD 131,000 for a single filer; employees also get a salary special deduction of TWD 218,000 (not included). Alternative minimum tax: 20% on income above TWD 7.5m, payable if higher. Employee social insurance: labor insurance 11.5% x 20% = 2.3% and employment insurance 1% x 20% = 0.2% on insured salary up to TWD 45,800 a month (about TWD 1,145 a month), plus NHI 5.17% x 30% = 1.551% on insured salary up to TWD 313,000 a month; the recorded 1.551% rate and TWD 3,756,000 annual cap cover only NHI, so labor and employment insurance (small, capped) are excluded. Foreigners cannot join the labor pension.

regimes.name: Employment Gold Card: 50% exemption on salary above TWD 3m
regimes.description: Gold Card holders working in Taiwan for the first time may apply for a 50% exemption on annual salary above TWD 3 million for the first 5 years (Gold Card site); KPMG adds that the holder must reside more than 183 days in the year and not have been a Taiwan tax resident in the five prior years, and that the exempt portion is excluded from the AMT. exemption_threshold is TWD 3,000,000: only salary above it is 50% exempt. The card itself lets a professional stay and work 1 to 3 years with no sponsor or job offer.
regimes.duration_note: Five years of tax incentive; card issued for 1 to 3 years and presumably renewed (renewal not verified). Exemption applies only to the part of salary above TWD 3m, so there is no minimum income to qualify for the card's tax benefit.

regimes.name: No digital nomad visa (Gold Card is the nearest route)
regimes.description: No digital nomad visa was found. Foreigners staying 183 days or more in a calendar year are tax residents; the Gold Card needs no sponsor and is the route for independent professionals. Resident status taxes income per the normal regime.

residence_routes: EU, US and other citizens: the Employment Gold Card (assessed on professional skills, no sponsor or job offer, 1-3 years) is the route for both remote workers and skilled employees; ordinary employer-sponsored work permits also exist but were not researched. Foreigners spending 183 days or more in a calendar year are tax residents.
